lang.title: Which language do you prefer?
lang.why: A few short questions so Arth fits your farm. It takes about 2 minutes.

name.title: What is your name?
name.why: So we can greet you every morning.

where.title: Where is your farm?
where.why: Your village and district let us show tomorrow's weather and the mandis closest to you.

crops.title: Which crops do you grow?
crops.why: Prices, spray reminders and disease help will be for these crops.

land.title: How much land do you farm?
land.why: It helps with spray and fertiliser amounts, and with schemes you qualify for.

ownership.title: Is the land your own or leased?
ownership.why: Some schemes, like PM-KISAN, need land in your name. This lets us show the ones you can get.

soil.title: What kind of soil is it?
soil.why: Soil decides which crops, fertiliser and watering suit your field.

water.title: How do you water your crops?
water.why: So we can tell you when to irrigate, and when the rain will do the job.

tank.title: How big is your sprayer tank?
tank.why: We work out the dose for one full tank, straight from the pesticide label.

experience.title: How long have you been farming?
experience.why: So we explain things at the right level: short for experts, more help for beginners.

farmingType.title: How do you farm?
farmingType.why: So treatment advice fits. If you farm organically, we show organic remedies first.

goals.title: What do you want help with most?
goals.why: Pick everything that matters to you. Your home screen will put these first.

sellsAt.title: Where do you usually sell?
sellsAt.why: So price alerts and selling tips match the way you sell.

livestock.title: Do you keep any animals?
livestock.why: Animals change fodder and manure needs, and some schemes we can show you.

ownershipHint.own: In my or my family's name

soilHint.black: Sticky when wet, cracks in summer
soilHint.laterite: Hard and brick-red, in hilly areas

waterHint.drip: Pipes that drip at each plant
waterHint.borewell: Pump from a bore or well

farmingHint.mixed: Organic on some fields or crops

review.title: Is this right, {{name}}?
review.sub: Tap any row to change it.
review.fixFirst: Fill in the rows marked Needed first
